item.title: Rate hike permanent?
item.description: A Hepburn Shire ratepayer believes last year's rate rise of 10% means that the "one-off" 7% added to the state government's cap of 3%, will continue to compound into future years. The ratepayer, who asked not to be named, wrote to the Department of Local Government earlier this year: "The ESC (Essential Services Commission) permitted a 10% increase over the 2024/5 rates (comprising the government's 3% cap plus an extra 7%). item.title: Crafting smiles with care – for generations
item.description: For three generations Davies Dental has looked after dental care in Ballarat, Maryborough and Melton – and from next month they will be in Daylesford too. The clinic excels in prosthetic dental solutions, specialising in full dentures, partial dentures, and implant-retained dentures.
